description:
Declare the JSON error-code enum through the vocabulary macro.

## Background

`ErrorCode` hand-writes `ALL`, `as_str` and `FromStr` (`crates/jit/src/output.rs:770-870`, `:1081`), with a schemars test that checks the hand table.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `ErrorCode` is declared through the macro, and its hand-written `ALL`, `as_str` and `FromStr` are gone, together with the schemars test the macro's owning test supersedes.
- [hard] REQ-02: JSON error payloads and the generated error-code reference are byte-identical.
title: Error codes come from one declaration
